safe_test_strategy: Compare read-only API object access under owner and non-owner identities.
expected_behavior: Object authorization must hold regardless of supplied identifier.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Protected object fields exposed to a verified non-owner with policy evidence.
impact: Unauthorized object access across tenants or users.
